Guidance & outlook: On a consolidated basis, the company reported operating revenues of INR433.4 crores in Q1 FY27 compared to INR346.9 crores in Q1 FY26, a growth of 24.9% Y-o-Y.
The gross profit for the quarter stood at INR193.9 crores compared to INR158.2 crores in Q1 FY26, a growth of 22.6% Y -o-Y.
EBITDA stood at INR65.5 crores in Q1 FY27 compared to INR55.7 crores in Q1 FY26, a growth of 17.5% Y-o-Y.
